result.prompt: An ordinary man in his forties sits at his own pale kitchen table, mid-sentence, looking just past the camera. In front of him: a ceramic cup of clear black filter coffee with visible steam, and the cream coffee bag. Morning light from a side window. Calm, specific, not a studio and not a smile-for-the-poster. Tall photograph with the cup, the bag, and any person kept in the middle band. Leave quiet space above and below so the same photo can be cropped to 9:16 later without cutting a face, the cup, or the bag. Natural Scandinavian daylight, the kind in a real Danish home, a small café, or the Aarhus roastery. Shot on a normal camera, a little imperfect, quiet and specific. Not a stock photo, not glossy advertising, not CGI, and not a catalog render. Any person is an ordinary adult, varied and natural, caught mid-action rather than posing. Not a recognizable real person, not a celebrity, and not a model on a set. No real brand logos, no clothing logos, no shop signs, and no nameplates. The coffee bag is always the same bag: a matte cream paper coffee bag with a deep green rectangular label that is only a solid color block, and a small blank cream sticker where a roast date would go. The label and the sticker have no writing at all. No text anywhere in the photograph: no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names, no readable labels, no captions, and no interface copy. Make the coffee itself the appetite: steam, a clear black filter coffee or a flat white with fine latte art, morning light, a real surface.
